title: Great app for tracking habits
body:
Used it for a while and I’m overall impressed.
The app is simple yet have a great feature set. Lets you track everything you want and reminds you about it when you need.
author: Mitachben

title: Started great but now useless
body:
Strides

I moved from Lift (which was very good but basic) to Strides. 

For few weeks the app worked beautiful but last Sunday 10/26/2014 the app just started to act up, the bars are not being updated and on the log page itself it inserted many rows of Sunday. 

I deleted one of trackers and re-created it (lost all the data) but it does the same. 

At this point the app is completely useless for me. 

I hope they will fix it because when working it is good app.

Update 12-5-2014:

It seems to be a bug that was related  to switch from  daylight , it is now work beautifully and change the rating to five stars.
author: Lian999
